Mahakal Temple Sets New Donation Record, Earning Over ₹140 Crore

The Mahakaleshwar Temple in Ujjain has set a new record for donations during the financial year 2025-26, receiving over ₹140 crore. This increase in revenue is attributed to a rise in the number of devotees, particularly after the development of 'Mahakal Lok'. The temple also received significant donations in gold and silver.
